facts.fact: Le Visionnaire reports the IPDCP communiqué of 5 November 2026 relies on articles 84 and 92 of Law No. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 on personal data protection, with sanctions of one to five years in prison and fines up to CFAF 20 million.
The IPDCP, the personal data protection authority, issued a communiqué on 5 November 2026 signed by its president, Colonel Bédiani Belei.
The IPDCP warned social media users and group administrators in its 5 November 2026 communiqué against publicly exposing others' personal data, with no decision on a named case reported.
